meta.title: About
meta.description: Our story and the values behind our work.

intro.heading: Small team. Thoughtful work.
intro.description: We like making useful things, asking better questions, and keeping the process simple.

story.heading: Our story
paragraphs: We started with a shared interest in doing good work without making it complicated. A few conversations turned into a first project, and things grew from there.
Today, we’re still curious. We take on work we care about, leave room to experiment, and share what we learn along the way.

items.heading: Stay curious
items.description: Listen first. There’s always something more to learn.

items.heading: Keep it honest
items.description: Say what you mean and make promises you can keep.

items.heading: Make it useful
items.description: Focus on the things that help someone in their everyday life.
